prompt:
Edit the supplied original game clothing diffuse UV atlas, texture 5633, into a higher-resolution hand-painted texture. This is an exact whole-canvas material restoration, not an illustration or a redesign. The reference is the complete original 128x128 RGBA atlas enlarged exactly nearest 8x to 1024x1024; retain the same square frame and ALL original UV field bounds, proportions and positions edge to edge, without crop, padding, letterbox, rotation or registration.

Preserve the original soft painted Silent Storm style, dark subdued relative palette and material hierarchy. Keep the left and upper-left dark olive/gold vertical striped fabric: its ten broad lighter vertical stripe runs across the upper field and intervening darker bands have the exact source pitch/phase; the lower left part retains the continuing cropped original bands, not a new pattern. Preserve the original narrow dark separators and precisely the source field corners. No more stripes and no denser woven or ribbed pattern.

The upper-middle brown leather shoe UV fields must retain their exact broad shapes, connected brown shading, original faint diagonal dark marks and dark blue-gray seam edges. These low-resolution marks are deliberately indistinct: keep a soft low-contrast painted wash, do not interpret them as separately readable laces, eyelets, stitching, perforations, buckle, metal hardware or new objects. Keep the brown upper-right strip and its single original thin muted gray horizontal separator at the same UV. The right-middle peach/brown skin-colored UV field remains a soft flat painted color wash with only the same broad source shadows: no pores, anatomy, wrinkles, freckles or beautification. Preserve the exact lower large gray-brown cloth field and its darker rightmost vertical strip, using very fine matte paint blending at the source pattern scale, no coarse grain, curls, hatching, weave, embroidery, new folds or sharp seams.

Keep the two existing small pale source marks in their exact fields and footprint: the pale rectangular patch near the left lower field junction, and the one tiny pale point in the lower-right dark strip. Do not multiply or enlarge them. Every other source dark/black field remains equally dark and opaque; no transparent holes. The actual original alpha is 255 everywhere, including 1166 RGB-black texels. Keep the whole output fully opaque. Keep the original illumination and relative edge tones; no glossy bevels, metallic sparkle, strong outline, sharpened rims, new borders or contrast boosts. Resolve only the existing painted transitions smoothly at higher resolution, retaining all uncertainty in tiny source marks. No text, symbols, extra hardware or invented details.
reference_recipe: Exact original128x128 wholeRGBA nearest8x1024x1024; no crop/padding/BBox/artistic edit; inverse wholeLanczos512x512, numeric gain and complete original A only.
